display_name: Magneti Marelli MIU1 / MIU G1 throttle-body ECU
notes: First-generation Magneti Marelli integrated throttle-body ECU (MIU1 / 32M1) fitted to Piaggio Beverly / Carnaby / MP3 / X7 / X8 / X Evo, Vespa GTS / GTV / LX / S, Gilera Nexus / Runner, Aprilia RS4 125 / SX 125 / SR Max 300, and Scomadi TL200. Offline XDF map inspection and tuning builds are supported; physical sessions remain blocked pending a verified MIU1 wire capture.
